landing.hero_title: See how AI engines and search engines read your site
landing.hero_subtitle: A free, anonymous audit of your pages for SEO, AEO, and GEO — no signup, no email, results in minutes.
landing.how_step1_body: Share your site and a few facts about your offering, market, and customers.
landing.how_step2_body: Our agents crawl a sample of your pages and analyze technical, keyword, and content signals.
landing.how_step3_body: Receive prioritized recommendations you can act on immediately.
landing.no_signup: No signup required. Reports are private and deleted after 7 days.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.p1: We crawl a representative sample of your pages and analyze them with specialized agents for technical health, keyword strategy, and content quality.
methodology.p2: Each finding carries a verification state and confidence level. Verified findings were directly observed on your pages; inferred findings are drawn from combined evidence.
methodology.p3: Recommendations are prioritized on your action board so you can fix the highest-impact issues first.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: This audit is anonymous. We do not ask for your name, email, or payment details.
privacy.p2: Reports are private: they are not indexed by search engines and are deleted after 7 days.
privacy.p3: We store only the audit findings, the pages sampled, and a cookie that counts your free audits.

terms.title: Terms
terms.p1: The free audit is provided as-is, with no guarantee of completeness or accuracy.
terms.p2: Only audit sites you own or are authorized to review.
terms.p3: Do not use the service to probe sites that prohibit automated access.
